description:
An arranged marriage, set to end in three years…that's all it was ever supposed to be. So now that it's over, why does it hurt so much? Kim Danha's confusion is only amplified by showers of affection and sweet "I love you"'s from her now ex-husband. Love is patient, love is kind, sure…but who said love was supposed to be mad?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Anytoon](https://www.anytoon.co.kr/webtoon/landing/episode/8266), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=9505715), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000056278), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230225), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/mad_marriage), [Toomics](https://toomics.com/click/intro?cno=7725&pid=webtoonguide)
